statement: a refused transformation must not be promoted to Escalate even when no inverse delta can be built (invert_available=false) (sem: SEM-gx-gate-342)
why: the one input that hits both E-M3-4's Escalate generation rule (invert_available=false) and AC-027's Deny precedence at once. If the three arms' order were swapped, a refused transformation would take the shape of 'asking a human for approval' -- routing to a person what two systems already refused. Since **Escalate is not Deny**, this is a different spelling of the same hole as false-admit (a 'road opens' even without admitting). (sem: SEM-gx-gate-343)

control.note: **the point is that the control is Escalate, not Admit**: the flag is the same, so the reason the negative case is Deny can be said to be the locator, not the flag. Making the control Admit would mean changing the flag, and it would stop being a pair (sem: SEM-gx-gate-344)
